name: pro.snapex/pay
title: SnapEX Pay
description: Crypto payments for AI agents: self-serve account, invoices, receiving, payouts, exchange.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional: "Bearer smk_…" merchant API key. Without it the agent calls create_account and the session goes on with the new key.

environmentVariables.name: SNAPEX_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Merchant API key (smk_…). Optional: create_account makes one and saves it to ~/.config/snapex-pay/credentials.json.
